item.title: Discourse Is Not Going Closed Source
item.description:
📝 Their reasoning is that AI has made open source too dangerous for SaaS companies. We are open source, we’ve always been open source, and we will continue to be open source. If your code is open source, your security team can scan it, your contributors can scan it, and independent researchers can scan it too.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.discourse.org/2026/04/discourse-is-not-going-closed-source/

item.title: Substrate AI Is Hiring Harness Engineers
item.description:
